name: keyvalet
description: KeyValet for Devin: stores keys you share into KeyValet automatically, blocks secrets from being hard-coded, and adds /keyvalet:add, /keyvalet:mode, /keyvalet:status, /keyvalet:lock and /keyvalet:audit. Requires the KeyValet install (curl -fsSL https://keyvalet.dev/install.sh | sh).
